headlines.title: Trump attends White House Correspondents' Dinner
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as President Trump attends the White House Correspondents’ Dinner, an event that was rescheduled after a thwarted attack last April. Mentalist Oz Pearlman will be performing at the event for journalists and their guests.

headlines.title: Trump orders signage warning visitors of ‘inaccurate information’ at Smithsonian
headlines.description: While he continues to seek control of the exhibits inside the Smithsonian Institution’s museums, President Donald Trump is trying a new tactic in the front yard.

headlines.title: Trump administration concedes that it canceled research grants in blue states
headlines.description: The Trump administration admitted that it terminated nearly 300 federal research grants “solely because” the projects were connected to states that voted against Trump in 2024

headlines.title: Paramount Skydance agrees to delay Warner Bros. merger
headlines.description: Paramount Skydance has agreed to delay its merger with Warner Brothers until June 2027, unless a federal judge issues a ruling on the suit filed by a dozen Democratic state attorneys general before then. Paramount will have to pay a penalty for every day the deal doesn't go through after a Sept. 30 deadline, potentially costing the company millions of dollars.

headlines.title: LeBron James announces he will join the Philadelphia 76ers
headlines.description: One of the NBA’s top talents, LeBron James, announced he plans to end his legendary career with the Philadelphia 76ers. In a social media post, James wrote “I believe I can help make the Philadelphia 76ers a championship team.” NBC News’ Sam Brock reports.

headlines.title: Cyclospora outbreak from tainted lettuce served at Taco Bell expands
headlines.description: Investigators are now tying Cyclospora cases in Illinois, Kansas, Oklahoma, and Pennsylvania to Taylor Farms iceberg lettuce served at Taco Bell. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin explains what people need to do to stay safe.

headlines.title: U.S. measles cases reach 35-year high in 2026, surpassing last year’s total
headlines.description: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported Friday that the United States has logged 2,318 measles cases in the first seven months of this year, surpassing last year’s total of 2,289.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.
